# FRAMEWORK-IMPROVEMENTS — suggestions for cap-evolve itself (cross-run)

NOT about this capability or this run's result — about what cap-evolve the FRAMEWORK should change so FUTURE runs (any capability, any project) go better: a confusing prompt section, a missing tool, a file you wished existed, a gate that felt wrong. Optional most iterations; add an entry whenever something about the framework itself (not the task) got in your way or surprised you.

## cand_0001 (spreadsheetbench verified probe)
- With an EMPTY seed and no task_template.md, the proposer has to reconstruct the built-in template from adapter source to know what the agent actually sees. Copying the effective default template (and the scorer's comparison rules) into the work dir as a read-only reference would save a large part of the diagnosis.
- rejected.jsonl is referenced by CLAUDE.md, but on iteration 1 it does not exist. Say "may be absent on the first iteration" to avoid a wasted search.
- The golden files are named *_golden.xlsx in the data dir, while the vendored evaluation.py refers to *_answer.xlsx. A one-line note on where the gold files live would help trace-vs-gold diffing.
